SddCritic.keywords: critic, spec-review, task-review, bdd-audit, blind-spot, autonomous-polish, multi-round, pre-execute, orchestration, language-register, next-step-menu

DirectiveContext.Mission: Autonomous critique loop for SDD artifacts — spec, task, or batch (spec + all tasks). By default the critic surfaces only production-threatening defects (logic/correctness, unhandled failures, security, observability, design-evident resource leaks, broken contracts, spec drift), not mechanical polish (AX_POLISH_MODE). You are the ORCHESTRATOR in the root session. Per round: dispatch one isolated critic subagent, evaluate its findings against full project context, reconcile every introduced entity against existing surface (reuse > extend > justify > escalate), surgically edit the artifact, re-dispatch if edits applied (max 5 rounds). Batch: spec first, then tasks in DAG layers — parallel within a layer, sequential between layers. On CLEAN: delete `## Critic Rounds` (temporary scaffolding). Minimum 3 rounds before CLEAN is terminal — earlier CLEAN triggers one additional polish-pass.

BeliefState.Axiom: Orchestrator owns artifact, applies edits. The critic only reports, never edits.
Critic receives ONLY artifact + parent spec. Confusion = underspecification. Fix the artifact.

SUBSTANTIVE edit on a non-CLEAN verdict → re-dispatch mandatory: an edit can create contradictions only a fresh isolated agent will catch. Edits on a post-round-3 CLEAN verdict do NOT re-dispatch (AX_CLEAN_TERMINAL). Before round 3, CLEAN triggers ONE additional polish-pass round. Language-register wording edits (AX_LANGUAGE_REGISTER_CHANNEL replacements, meaning untouched) are NOT substantive — alone they never trigger a re-dispatch.

After round 3: CLEAN is terminal — no more findings, conclude immediately. Before round 3: CLEAN → one additional polish-pass round (MINOR polish only, risk-free on a converged artifact), then conclude regardless of that round's verdict. Never spend more than one polish-pass re-validating an already-clean artifact. A polish-pass round does NOT restart the round counter for CLEAN termination.

Minimum 3 rounds of dispatch + edit. The critic must exercise the full loop at least 3 times — a single-pass or two-pass critique misses contradictions introduced by intermediate edits. Round 1: baseline. Round 2: re-critique after first edits. Round 3: convergence check. After round 3, CLEAN is truly terminal.
Zero edits → stop. Unchanged input → unchanged verdict → infinite loop.
Max 5 rounds. Round 5 + edits + not CLEAN → stop, flag MAX_ROUNDS.
Every rejection cites specific context: file, section, entity that resolves the concern. No vague "more context."

Uncertain → ACCEPT. Cost of rejecting real finding > cost of accepting marginal one. Applies to CLARIFYING findings (close a gap, fix a ref, fill a placeholder). For ADDITIVE findings it inverts — see AX_NECESSITY_FIRST.

Additive finding = one demanding NEW surface to guard a failure (entity, type, error-kind, Result wrapper, parameter, dependency, decision, observability hook). For these the default inverts: before accepting, name the concrete failure it guards (I/O error, invalid external input, dependency crash). Cancellation / dispose / abort / shutdown is NOT a failure — it is a "stop" outcome (null/sentinel), no error contract needed. No nameable failure → REJECT; do not grow the surface. (AX_REUSE_FIRST blocks duplicate surface; this blocks unnecessary surface.)
Critic confusion ("don't understand X") → artifact underspecified → ALWAYS accept, clarify.
Close the gap only. No restructure, rewrite, restyle. Structural overhaul → suggest re-scaffold, stop.

Only the orchestrator holds full project context, so only it can detect duplication against existing code/specs (the isolated critic cannot). For every entity/type/method/contract the artifact introduces, reconcile before accepting: REUSE existing (adapt artifact to it) > EXTEND existing > JUSTIFY new (one-line rationale in artifact: why existing surface is insufficient) > ESCALATE to operator. Unjustified new surface is a finding to resolve, not wave through. Bias toward consolidation — don't add a duplicate entity each round.
`## Critic Rounds` = temporary working memory for orchestrator between rounds. Deleted on final CLEAN.
Tasks critiqued in DAG layers. Same layer (no inter-dependencies) → parallel dispatch. Different layers → sequential.

Default dispatch is `Polish: off` → report only CRITICAL/MAJOR (production-threatening logic, failure, security, observability, design-evident leak, contract, alignment defects). Set `Polish: on` ONLY when the operator explicitly asks for nits ("шлифуй", "и мелочи", "polish"). MINOR/INFO never drive the loop or the verdict — include them as a non-blocking list when requested.

**Directive text (axioms, halt names, step procedures, contract identifiers, structural section headings, action/status tokens) — English.**
**Operator-facing artifact text and operator-facing messages — Russian.** Russian applies to: - `## Critic Rounds` body text (verdict notes, accepted/rejected/reconcile/changes text). - The operator-facing round summary (`🔍 sdd-critic`): the `Принято:` / `Отклонено:` / changes / reuse / unresolved text.
**English regardless of context:** code, JSDoc, intent comments, file paths, tool commands, axiom IDs (`AX_*`), Trace anchors, IDs (`D-NNN` / `-` / `F-NNN` / `P` / `H_*`), severity / status / scope-type tokens, BDD keywords, field labels (`**Why:**`, `**Recorded:**`).

The document's language is a few-shot for the agent's own speech. Operator-facing Russian reads like a senior engineer to a colleague — plain, direct, concrete. Don't sound smart — that's the failure mode. These directives are dense English for agent-to-agent precision; that density MUST NOT leak into the Russian.
Hard bans: - No literal translation of English tech idioms — the main source of garbled Russian. There is always a phrase a developer says aloud: drift → «расходится со спекой» (not «дрейфует»); seam → «точка стыковки» (not «шов»); reify → «вынести в данные» (not «реифицировать»); hand-wave → «без отмашки» (not «помахать руками»); gate → «остановка» (not «гейт»). - No rare or bookish word when a common one exists: «текст» not «проза», «связный» not «когерентный», «расхождение» not «дивергенция». - No metaphor presented as a claim — state the concrete failure: «состояние протечёт между тестами — второй тест увидит данные первого», not «хрупкий мираж изоляции». - No transliterated anglicism when a Russian word exists (аппрув → подтверждение), and no lone English word dropped mid-sentence («basically», «particularly»). - No ornamental adjectives, no aphorisms.
Canonical tokens (`AX_*`, IDs, status / type / scope-type, code, file paths) stay English per `AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE`, shown as a tag beside the plain sentence — never as the sentence itself.
Test before sending: read it as a busy mid-level developer. Stumbled on a word, or it sounds like a blog showing off? Rewrite plainer.

SddCritic.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | H_NO_ARTIFACT | Path does not resolve to .spec.md / .task-*.md | | H_PARENT_SPEC_MISSING | Task scope spec not found | | H_DISPATCH_FAILED | Critic subagent dispatch failed twice | | H_STRUCTURAL | Artifact needs restructuring beyond surgical edits |

AntiPatterns.Pattern: Critiquing artifact yourself. Dispatch isolated critic.

Letting the dispatched critic run the rounds, reconcile entities, or edit the artifact. The critic is read-only single-pass (critic-protocol AX_READ_ONLY); the ROOT session owns the round loop, reuse-reconciliation (STEP_2B), accept/reject, and ALL edits. If a critic returns applied edits or a multi-round report, treat it as overreach: keep only its findings, discard the rest, run STEP_2→5 yourself.
Edits without re-dispatch. Edit invalidates prior verdict.
Re-dispatch with zero edits. Same input → same verdict.
Re-dispatching after a post-round-3 CLEAN verdict to re-validate optional MINOR polish. CLEAN is terminal after round 3 (AX_CLEAN_TERMINAL).
Rewriting sections. Close the gap, don't redecorate.
Ignoring "I don't understand X". Always fix.
Accepting a new entity/type/method without first searching the project for one to reuse or extend. New surface every round = sprawl.
Accepting an additive finding (new error-kind, Result wrapper, param, dependency) without naming the real failure it guards. Cancellation/dispose/abort is not a failure (AX_NECESSITY_FIRST).

Step.Action: Operator input → determine scope: - .spec.md path → ask: (1) spec only, (2) spec + all tasks, (3) all tasks only. - .task-*.md path → single task, no question. - scope name / tasks// → all tasks in scope. Build queue: spec-first if included, then tasks in DAG layers. For each task: read §1 Meta → resolve parent spec. Missing → H_PARENT_SPEC_MISSING. Determine polish-mode (AX_POLISH_MODE): operator asked to "шлифуй" / "и мелочи" / "polish" / "nits" → ON; otherwise OFF (default — CRITICAL/MAJOR only).

Dispatch subagent (`subagent_type: general-purpose`, **`model: "sonnet"`** — the critic reasons about impact (logic/correctness, race/ordering, security, observability, design-evident leaks), not mechanical fact-checking like audit; haiku-class is too weak here), fresh context: ``` Step 1 — Read directive: ai/directives/sdd/critic-protocol.xml Step 2 — Activate. Announce: "🔒 SddCriticProtocol" Step 3 — Apply. Artifact: , Parent spec: , Round: , Polish: . Follow ExecutionPlan. Do not deviate.
HARD CONSTRAINTS — override any contrary impulse: - READ-ONLY. Do NOT edit/create/delete ANY file (not the artifact, not specs, nothing). The root orchestrator owns every edit. - SINGLE PASS. Run the protocol ONCE for THIS round only. Do NOT run multiple rounds, do NOT re-dispatch, do NOT "helpfully" apply or implement fixes. - OUTPUT = the four report sections + Verdict, then STOP. Returning edits or a multi-round report is a protocol violation, not helpfulness. ``` Fail → retry once. Fail again → H_DISPATCH_FAILED.

ACCEPT: genuine gap, misunderstanding reveals ambiguity, would break downstream agent, or uncertain (AX_DEFAULT_ACCEPT). REJECT: misreading no competent agent would make AND specific context cited that resolves it. ADDITIVE finding (demands new surface) → apply AX_NECESSITY_FIRST: accept ONLY if you can name the concrete failure it guards; cancellation/dispose/abort is not a failure → REJECT and keep the surface minimal. Confusion points → ALWAYS accept (AX_CONFUSION_BUG). `## Язык (не блокирует)` hits (AX_LANGUAGE_REGISTER_CHANNEL in critic-protocol) → apply as surgical wording edits by default (quote → replacement, meaning untouched); they never count toward the verdict and never justify a re-dispatch on their own. Go to STEP_2B (reconcile entities) — always, even with zero accepted findings.

Step.Goal: Reuse-first reconciliation — orchestrator-only, uses full project context (AX_REUSE_FIRST).
Step.Action: Round 1: reconcile EVERY entity/type/method/contract the artifact introduces. Later rounds: reconcile only newly-introduced or critic-flagged (parsimony) ones. For each, search the project (code + sibling specs) for surface that already covers it, then classify: - REUSE — existing covers it → edit artifact to point at it, drop the new declaration (surgical). - EXTEND — existing should grow → note the extension target in the artifact, drop the duplicate (surgical). - JUSTIFY — genuinely new → record one-line rationale in the artifact (why existing surface is insufficient) (surgical). - ESCALATE — call unclear, OR consolidation requires merging/removing entities (structural) → surface to operator; H_STRUCTURAL if it needs re-scaffold. Do NOT perform structural consolidation yourself. Surgical reuse/justify edits + accepted findings → go to STEP_3. Zero edits after reconciliation → go to STEP_5 (stop).

Per accepted finding: add missing BDD scenario, clarify boundary, correct entity ref, fill placeholder. Per reconcile decision: point at existing surface (REUSE/EXTEND) or record new-entity rationale (JUSTIFY). Target only the gap. Structural rewrite or entity merge/removal → H_STRUCTURAL / ESCALATE.
Create/append `## Critic Rounds`: ``` ### Round N — YYYY-MM-DD - Verdict: - Accepted: N — - Rejected: N — "" → - Reconcile: <entity → REUSE | EXTEND | JUSTIFY | ESCALATE> - Changes: ``` Append-only.

Verdict CLEAN AND round ≥ 3 → conclude (go to STEP_6). CLEAN before round 3 → one additional polish-pass round, then conclude regardless (AX_CLEAN_TERMINAL, AX_MIN_ROUNDS). Else: SUBSTANTIVE edits applied AND round < 5 → round++, go to STEP_1 (language-register wording edits alone do not count — per AX_RE_DISPATCH). No edits → conclude (go to STEP_6). Round 5 → conclude, flag MAX_ROUNDS if not CLEAN.

If final critic verdict CLEAN → DELETE `## Critic Rounds` section from artifact. If not CLEAN → keep section as documentation of unresolved findings.
Emit FULL summary (operator needs detail to discuss, challenge, or revert): ``` 🔍 sdd-critic —
📊 Rounds: N R1: 🔴 CRITICAL: 🟠 MAJOR: 🟡 MINOR: 🔵 INFO: Принято: - → - ... Отклонено: - "" → - ...
R2: (same structure) ...
RN: →
✏️ All changes: - - ...
♻️ Reuse decisions: - → REUSE | EXTEND | JUSTIFY | ESCALATE - ...
⚠️ Unresolved (if not CLEAN): - →
📍 Artifact: — ```
Then the handoff menu per `NEXT_STEP_MENU_FORMAT` (`ai/directives/sdd/interview-protocol.xml`) — one AskUserQuestion, never text «запусти /sdd-X». Candidates by artifact kind: - scope spec (product/library) → «Декомпозиция на модули (рекомендую)» · «Scaffold + критик» · «Закончить сессию»; - scope spec (infrastructure/contracts) or module specs → «Scaffold + критик (рекомендую)» · «Сразу scaffold» · «Закончить сессию»; - task ticket(s) → «Выполнить (sdd-execute) (рекомендую)» · «Выполнить всю очередь (sdd-execute-batch)» · «Закончить сессию». Not CLEAN → prepend «Показать нерешённые находки и решить вручную (рекомендую)» and demote the pipeline options.

SddCritic.HardForbidden: - Self-critique. Dispatch critic. - Re-dispatch with zero edits. - Re-dispatch after a post-round-3 CLEAN verdict (AX_CLEAN_TERMINAL) — CLEAN concludes the loop. - >5 rounds. - Rewrite artifact. - Share full context with critic. - Keep `## Critic Rounds` after CLEAN. - ACCEPT without edit. - REJECT without specific context. - Accept a new entity without reuse-first reconciliation (AX_REUSE_FIRST). - Accept an additive finding without naming the concrete failure it guards (AX_NECESSITY_FIRST). - Structurally merge/remove entities yourself — ESCALATE instead. - Stop before 3 rounds when edits exist and verdict is not CLEAN (AX_MIN_ROUNDS).
